name: pb-orca-mcp
description: Drive PowerBuilder headlessly through the ORCA API: inspect PBLs, export an object to a file, compile it back, build EXE/PBD, and keep the ws_objects/ text projection in step so git sees every change. Bundles the MCP server with the two agent skills.
_note: This manifest is only the Claude Code packaging of a client-neutral project, and one optional install channel among several.
The skills under skills/ are agentskills-standard SKILL.md files any skill-aware agent can load, and docs/ is the cross-client source of truth.
Nothing here is required: registering the server with any MCP client is a standard mcpServers block. See docs/getting-started.md.
